definitions: to lift something or someone from a surface
to collect someone or something, often by car
to learn a new skill or language informally
to notice or become aware of something
examples: Could you pick up the dry cleaning on your way home?
I need to pick up my friend from the airport.
She picked up Spanish quickly while living in Madrid.
The microphone picked up every sound.
Business is starting to pick up after a slow period.
pastTenses: picked up (past simple), picked up (past perfect)
